idea-plugin.name: Data Lens: CSV, Excel & JSON Explorer
idea-plugin.description:
Interactive data workbench for CSV, TSV, Excel (XLSX/XLS/ODS) and JSON / JSON Lines files.

  • Fast virtualized grid: sort, multi-column filters, search, inline editing, copy/paste ranges
  • Column profiling with histograms, charts (bar, line, area, scatter, donut, histogram)
  • Transforms: computed columns (formula language), find & replace, dedupe, split, group-by / pivot
  • JSON tree, interactive graph and table views, JSONPath queries, TypeScript type generation
  • Export to CSV, TSV, XLSX, JSON, JSON Lines, SQL, HTML and Markdown

Open a CSV or spreadsheet to see the Data Lens tab; for JSON, switch to the Data Lens tab at the bottom of the editor.
